evals.name: xlsx-records-formula-loss
evals.given: An engineering-calculation workbook is extracted to per-sheet CSV with openpyxl data_only=True.
evals.then: The page records captured=computed cell values and KNOWN loss=formulas/named ranges/charts, and is marked completeness:partial queued for a formula-graph lane.

evals.name: pptx-records-diagram-loss
evals.given: A results deck whose key content is plotted figures is extracted to slide text + tables.
evals.then: It records that diagrams/plots AND speaker notes were not captured and flags the page for image/diagram + notes capture rather than shipping it as complete.

evals.name: msg-records-attachment-drop
evals.given: An .msg email thread with attachments is extracted to thread text.
evals.then: Attachments are recorded as dropped; the page is partial and the attachments are queued for separate harvesting.

evals.name: no-host-path-committed
evals.given: The extractor reads sources under $FDAS_CORPUS rather than a hardcoded /mnt path.
evals.when: The diff of any committed page/extract is grepped for host mount paths.
evals.then: No absolute host mount path appears; provenance is recorded as corpus-relative-path + sha256.

evals.name: faithful-but-incomplete-not-marked-done
evals.given: A docx is extracted faithfully but contains embedded figures the text dump omits.
evals.when: The ledger names the image loss.
evals.then: The page is not promoted to the trusted/complete set; it carries completeness:partial with the recorded gap.

evals.name: ace-wave2-csv-dialect-and-sidecar-required
evals.given: A numeric CSV or semicolon-delimited engineering export is entering the ACE wave-2 ledger.
evals.then: The ledger records delimiter, row-width validation, ragged-row status, content digest, and requires a units/sign/coordinate convention sidecar before the row can be treated as usable.

evals.name: ace-wave2-ragged-delimited-excluded
evals.given: A delimited file has inconsistent row widths after dialect detection.
evals.then: The row uses ragged_delimited, routes excluded_no_ingest, and reports the hard exclusion outside the ingestion-success denominator.

evals.name: ace-wave2-non-durable-classifier-row
evals.given: A #53 spreadsheet or CSV classifier record includes a target path, retrieval metadata, lifecycle state, private sidecar, or persistent metric.
evals.then: The row is rejected because durable-output fields belong to the #61 workflow, not the #53 classifier surface.
